Hero.Title: M&A and transaction advisory for Swiss deals
Hero.Description: Transaction advisory for Swiss founders, family businesses and investors: we guide buy-side and sell-side transactions with disciplined process management, valuation expertise and post-deal integration support.

Presentation.Title: Swiss M&A: buy-side, sell-side and valuation
Presentation.Subtitle: Preparing, negotiating and closing transactions with confidence
Intro: Ark Fiduciaire delivers hands-on M&A advisory across French and German speaking Switzerland. We shape deal strategy, prepare financial models, coordinate due diligence and lead negotiations so you can stay focused on the business.

Our team covers the key searches people use when planning a deal — Swiss M&A advisory, company valuation, buy-side due diligence, sell-side preparation, private equity exits and succession planning. We translate that demand into a clear roadmap tailored to your objectives.
We leverage transaction data, market comparables and management insights to secure terms that reflect the true value of your company while protecting founder interests.
Presentation.PartnerNote: For legal structuring, SPA drafting and regulatory filings we work hand in hand with our trusted law firm partners.
Services: Buy-side and sell-side mandates, including target screening and process management
Financial modelling, scenario planning and independent company valuation
Vendor and buy-side due diligence coordination across finance, tax and HR streams
Deal negotiation support covering letters of intent, SPA terms and closing checklists
Post-merger integration planning with a focus on finance, payroll and reporting setups
Succession and carve-out projects for Swiss SMEs seeking a smooth handover

Strengths.Title: Local mid-market focus
Strengths.Desc: We understand how Swiss owners, cantonal authorities and domestic lenders approach M&A so we can anticipate issues early.

Strengths.Title: Integrated specialists
Strengths.Desc: Accounting, tax and payroll experts join the project team so operational risks and earn-out mechanics stay under control.

Strengths.Title: Regulatory awareness
Strengths.Desc: Experience with SRO expectations, SECO approvals and cross-border data sharing keeps transactions compliant.

Strengths.Title: Pragmatic reporting
Strengths.Desc: We deliver concise memos, data room trackers and negotiation briefs so decision makers stay aligned throughout the process.

LongFormSections.Title: Who we support
Body: Entrepreneurs, SMEs, investors and groups preparing an acquisition, sale, succession or structured financing round.
We help when figures, governance and documentation need to be ready for demanding discussions.

LongFormSections.Title: What we produce
Body: Financial models, valuation analyses, vendor preparation, due diligence coordination, data rooms, transaction reporting and integration plans.
Deliverables are designed to help management decide, negotiate and document decisions.

LongFormSections.Title: Process
Body: We clarify objectives, timeline, scope, available information, sensitive points and stakeholders.
The engagement moves through diagnosis, preparation, execution, negotiation, closing and post-transaction follow-up where needed.

LongFormSections.Title: Cost drivers
Body: Costs depend on deal size, data quality, number of parties, due diligence depth and legal or tax coordination.
Specialized partners are involved when the matter goes beyond normal fiduciary or financial scope.

Questions.Question: What does an M&A adviser do in Switzerland?
Questions.Answer: We advise companies in French-speaking and German-speaking Switzerland throughout the transaction: buy-side and sell-side mandates, financial models, due diligence and negotiation.

Questions.Question: Can you value my company?
Questions.Answer: Yes, we prepare financial models, scenarios and an independent valuation, combining market data, sector comparables and operational reality.

Questions.Question: How does an M&A engagement run?
Questions.Answer: It moves in stages: diagnosis, preparation, execution, negotiation, closing, and follow-up after the transaction when needed.

Questions.Question: Who handles the legal side and the SPA?
Questions.Answer: For legal structuring, drafting the SPA and regulatory filings, we work with our partner law firm.

Questions.Question: Who do you work for?
Questions.Answer: We support founders, families, SMEs, investors and groups preparing an acquisition, a sale, a succession or a significant fundraising.
